name: Deploy Docs

# Builds the combined documentation site and deploys it to GitHub Pages:
#   v6 (latest) at the root, v5 under /v5/.
# The v6 source lives on master and the v5 source on the 5.x branch; this workflow
# checks out both refs explicitly, so the branch a run is started from does not matter.
# It runs only on a manual dispatch (Actions > Deploy Docs > Run workflow), so docs
# merged to master go live when a release is published, not before.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

# Allow the GITHUB_TOKEN to deploy to GitHub Pages.
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow one concurrent deployment; don't cancel in-progress runs.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout v6 source (master)
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: master
          path: v6-src
      - name: Checkout v5 source (5.x)
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: 5.x
          path: v5-src
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            v6-src/package-lock.json
            v5-src/package-lock.json
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Build v6 site (root)
        working-directory: v6-src
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run docs:build
      - name: Build v5 site (base /v5/)
        working-directory: v5-src
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run docs:build
      - name: Assemble combined site
        run: |
          rm -rf _site
          cp -r v6-src/docs/.vitepress/dist _site
          mkdir -p _site/v5
          cp -r v5-src/docs/.vitepress/dist/. _site/v5/
      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
